judgment: K1 formal 100-kill evidence cannot be produced: every no-trace arm that entered the first save window froze at a 0.25–0.44 s / ~0.6–4 MiB boundary after park. The only arms that completed (V1–V3) wrote a flush+fsync trace line at every boundary to a separate file, which is a timing-changing confound and is not admissible as formal evidence. Therefore K1 is 未接上（环境冻结）, not a product failure and not an atomicity pass.
